The proposed price is significantly above where Brighthouse closed trading on Thursday, at $45.26 per share, which gave the company a market value of roughly $2.6 billion.  Talks are considered advanced between Brighthouse and Aquarian, a holding company focused on insurance and asset management businesses that is backed by investors including RedBird Capital Partners and Abu Dhabi state fund Mubadala, the sources said.
